name: Togame
source:
A gloomy girl with an oppressive air around her. 

[Spoiler]Sickness: 

Phygephilia: Sexual arousal derived from "running away". Be it the past, the future, or relationships; the act itself arouses her.

By betraying her friend and running away from facing her, she developed Phygephilia and only further defiled her memories of her.

She was incredibly lonely and a coward. She decided to commit group suicide because she was afraid of doing it alone.

Now that she has allies, she's not afraid to face anything, be it the past or the future.[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile]

[spoiler]Her real name is Hakanagi Souko (儚木 奏子), and her nickname used to be Kana (カナ). She was a friend of [url=/c23154]Takuwai Somari[/url].[/spoiler]
